preconditions.description: The length of the happy string is between 1 and 10 inclusive.
The kth happy string to be returned is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output == '' if len(generateHappyStrings(n)) < k else generateHappyStrings(n)[k-1]
postconditions.description: The output is the kth happy string of length n in lexicographical order, or an empty string if there are less than k happy strings of length n.
